title: Profile golden test case
$comment: Draft v1 (T017-FIX3, decisions 197 and 199): golden_case.v0 plus the required request.retrieval (disabled runs the case with rag.enabled false and no knowledge-base access, R-009) and expect.grounding (required: the case passes only with envelope retrieval.state retrieved and a success or repaired status, so a degraded run never passes it). One file golden/<id>.yaml per id in the manifest's golden_tests (docs/stages/P-profiles.md). A schema_version 1 (golden_case.v0) file is refused by profile check.

source_image.description: a file name under golden/, or none

retrieval.description: enabled needs rag.enabled true in the configuration; disabled runs this case only with rag.enabled false
